items.name: theme
items.title: Glaze theme
items.description: Support file: tokens, scoped base styles, the Tailwind v4 theme mapping and Glaze's recipes: glass, the card shell, the pill field and the overlay.
items.author: design.how
items.docs:
Glaze is scoped: its styles apply only inside an element with the class glaze.
1. Import the theme once, in the root layout, as its own stylesheet (not an @import in globals.css): import '@/components/glaze/styles.css'
2. Put className="glaze" on the element that holds Glaze UI, usually <body>. Glaze's classes work on the elements inside it, in your own code too, not on that element itself.
3. Wrap the app inside that element in <GlazePortalProvider> from '@/lib/glaze/portal', so dialogs and menus keep the theme.
Dark mode: put data-theme="dark" on the glaze element or any ancestor, such as <html>. The theme does not follow the system setting (prefers-color-scheme) on its own.
Components: npx shadcn@latest add https://design.how/r/glaze/<name>.json; https://design.how/r/glaze/registry.json lists them all.
